additional_info.subject: ID0455713-DC/Si-D/AT- [RVP / T9 170005102] No PLC Link CRM:02832000604
additional_info.body:
Hello Johannes, good morning.
As we previously discussed, the "no PLC link" means that the EV failed to transmit a part of chain process of the SLAC communication between EVSE and EV.
From our side, the only thing we can do is tell you in which part it fails as it's nothing easily troubleshoot and usually these cases revolve around having a Vehicle integration.
Let me know your feedback or if I should close the ticket.
Unfortunately, AWS is currently down so I cannot offer you a screenshot of all successfull sessions.
Best regards,
Francisco
